summary: Google DeepMind announced two new Gemini model variants, 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite, describing improved coding, knowledge-work and multimodal performance alongside reduced token usage.

mechanisms.reason: The post states the new Flash model reduces token usage per output, which is a stated efficiency claim though without a numeric figure.
mechanisms.quote: 3.6 Flash: our workhorse model delivers better coding, knowledge work, and multimodal performance while reducing token usage.

practices.reason: An engineering team evaluating Gemini variants for coding and reasoning workloads would want to test the claimed token-usage reduction and quality gains before switching models.
